risk_note: RV2 (catalog/** RV1, app.module.ts). Search and detail caches in Redis (300 s hit window on now - fetched_at, 3600 s physical TTL for cleanup only, keys start with app_id and hold only the union parameters actually sent, no pid / relation_id / user / session; only normalized public fields are stored, cards are re-quoted and links re-registered on every request; stale entries up to min(stale_max_age_s, 3600) only on dependency failure). Search session hardening: Redis Lua CAS for seen keys with merge-and-retry, HMAC-signed cursor (field keyring in staging / prod, process key in local / test), page_no cap 100 with has_more kept as reported by the union, material fallback narrowed to union / governance / business errors, Redis outage keeps the first page without next_cursor. Landing title reads the same detail cache. Written by hand.
